extName.description: Extension name in the Chrome Web Store and in Chrome. Max 75 characters.

extDescription.message: Right-click a word selected on any web page to add it to your ElfaLingo deck. Works with your own ElfaLingo server.

menuAdd.description: Context menu item over selected text. Chrome replaces %s with the selection.

titleIdle.message: Select a word on a page and right-click it to add it

problem_signed_out.message: Not signed in — click the icon to sign in

problem_account_disabled.message: The account is disabled — ask the administrator of your ElfaLingo server

problem_unreachable.message: No connection to the ElfaLingo server

problem_foreign.message: The server address does not lead to ElfaLingo — check it in the settings

problem_server_error.message: The server returned an error — words will be sent again later

resultNothing.message: Nothing to add: the selection has no word

tagline.message: Add words to your deck from any website

statusOk.message: Connected — selected words go straight to your deck

hintServer.message: The address you open ElfaLingo at, for example https://elfalingo.example.com

hintRemember.message: The password is never stored. With this option the session token is kept until you sign out; without it, until the browser closes.

warningInsecure.message: This address uses http: the password and your words travel unencrypted. Use https for a server that is not on this computer.

signOutNote.message: To change the server or the account, sign out and sign in again. Words not yet sent are discarded on sign-out.

howToSelect.message: Select a word on any page, right-click it and choose “Add to ElfaLingo”.

howToList.message: Several words separated by commas are added one by one. A word goes to the queue and ElfaLingo fills in the card, just like a word typed in the app.

legendAdded.message: the word was sent to your deck (“+3” — three words)

legendDuplicate.message: the deck already has this word

legendRejected.message: not added: the selection is not a word

legendProblem.message: no connection to the server (grey icon) or you need to sign in (amber). Words are kept and sent automatically once it is fixed.

privacyNote.message: The extension talks only to the server set here and sends it nothing but the words you choose to add.

error_invalid_url.message: This does not look like a web address.

error_permission_denied.message: Without access to this server the extension cannot send words. Sign in again and allow access.

error_unreachable.message: The server does not answer. Check the address and your connection.

error_foreign.message: Something answered at this address, but it is not ElfaLingo. Check the address.

error_too_many_attempts.message: Too many failed attempts. Sign-in is locked for 5 minutes.

error_server_error.message: The server returned an error. Try again later.

error_signed_out.message: The session has ended. Sign in again.
